about: Aggregate internship and first-job outcomes for CCAIR and Georgia State CIS students, rendered by scripts/build-students.mjs at /ccair/students/outcomes/. While rows is empty the page says the data is being collected, carries noindex and stays out of the sitemap.

privacy: Enter group counts only. Never enter a student's name, ID, email or any other field that identifies one person.
Any group with fewer than minCell students is not shown. Suppressed groups are added together into one 'Other (smaller groups)' line, which is shown only if it reaches minCell itself.
medianPay is shown only when count is at least minPayN. Leave it out otherwise.
employerName is shown only when employerConsent is true, meaning the employer agreed to be named. Without consent the row counts toward its employer type only.
Record where each count came from in source (for example the career office report and its date).

fields.year: Graduation or internship year (number, for example 2026)
fields.program: Program label, for example 'BBA CIS', 'MS Information Systems', 'PhD CIS' or 'CCAIR research students'
fields.employerType: Private sector | Government | Nonprofit | Higher education | Continuing education
fields.role: Job family, ideally a Pathway Finder role name (for example 'SOC Analyst') or 'Other security role' or 'Non-security role'
fields.count: Number of students in this group (whole number)
fields.medianPay: Optional. Median annual base pay in US dollars, only when count >= minPayN
fields.employerConsent: Optional. true when the employer agreed to be named
